narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A square ending in six needs a number ending in six. That means only forty six squared and fifty six squared end in six.
<bookmark mark='four'/>Try thirty four, where four times four is sixteen, which ends in six.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A number ending in four can give a square ending in six too.
